claims.claim: Original copies, not photocopies or local reprints
claims.evidence: No close-up of print quality, paper texture, ISBN/barcode, or publisher imprint page is shown to confirm authenticity.
Only front covers are shown; no interior pages are visible in either photo.

risks.risk: Books could be local reprints or photocopies rather than original publisher copies
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the copyright/imprint page, ISBN barcode, and paper/print quality under good light
risks.if_unproven: price as a low-cost reprint/photocopy, not an original edition

risks.risk: Interior pages may have writing, highlighting, or missing pages
risks.proof: Photos or a short video flipping through the full interior of both books

risks.risk: Spine and back cover condition unknown (creases, cracks, tears)
risks.proof: Clear photo of spine and back cover of each book

risks.risk: Possible water damage, odor, or foxing not visible from front cover
risks.proof: Photo of page edges and any discoloration, plus seller statement on storage conditions

proof_requests: Photo of the copyright/imprint page and ISBN barcode for both books
Video flipping through all interior pages of both books
Clear photo of spine and back cover of each book
Close-up of page edges to check for water damage or discoloration
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies the two specific books, so a worst-case price (assuming reprint status, possible writing, and unseen wear) can be set; authenticity and interior condition remain unverified pending further photos.
